taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: Archive extraction and Zip Slip boundaries — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect archive format/library, member path handling, links, extraction root, overwrite policy and expansion/file-count limits. Record worker identity and publication path.
controls.controlled_verification: Build a tiny owned archive containing a normal member and one outside-root or link-mediated member justified by the library semantics. Extract only into a disposable tree and inspect actual file destinations. Check limits with small deterministic fixtures, not a decompression bomb.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An unsafe member name in an archive is not a write if the extractor rejects or confines it. File traversal, link authority and unbounded expansion are separate mechanisms and may need distinct findings.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Validate effective destinations for members and links before write, constrain overwrite/expansion and preserve valid archives. Retest normal extraction, the exact escape path and cleanup after rejection.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
